messages:
alex: spontaneous ask  dusk bodega vibes playlist ~40min (no synth / no metal) + one short film under 45min?
priya: quick 40: bodega dusk mix:
1. Antônio Carlos Jobim - Wave (6:20)
2. João Gilberto - O Pato (2:05)
3. Chet Baker - Almost Blue (2:20)
4. Astrud Gilberto - Meditation (3:05)
5. Norah Jones - Dont Know Why (3:07)
6. Madeleine Peyroux - Dance Me To The End Of Love (4:00)
7. Nick Drake - From The Morning (3:35)
8. Sufjan Stevens - The Only Thing (4:02)
(total ~28-30min, repeat or add a soft outro to hit 40)
hugo: short film: "La Jetée"  28min, haunting photo-narrative, perfect after that playlist.
marta: love la jetee. alternative: "The Lunch Date" (12min) if you want something lighter.
alex: vote: La Jetée (:one:) or Lunch Date (:two:)? react with :one:/:two:
priya: :one:
hugo: :one: :film_projector:
marta: :two: fine with either
alex: La Jetée it is. jukebox-bot, can you queue priya's mix and set reminder 2024-06-15T19:30:00Z for a mini watch party?
jukebox-bot: queued mix to #random-playlists (https://open.spotify/placeholder) and set reminder for 2024-06-15T19:30:00Z  watch La Jetée. :alarm_clock:
